card.name: Antidepressant suicidality pooled-analysis sentence
card.fires_on: Small words and nouns inside the standard antidepressant warning sentence about pooled analyses of placebo-controlled trials, such as 'of', 'studies', 'in' and 'most'.

modes.label: Pooled analyses wording
modes.description: Words in 'The pooled analyses of placebo-controlled trials/studies in adults or children'.
modes.example: The pooled analyses of placebo-controlled<< studies>> in adults with MDD or other psychiatric

modes.label: Risk in young patients
modes.description: The word 'most' in the statement about increased risk in young patients across drugs studied.
modes.example: there was an increased risk identified in young patients for<< most>> drugs studied.

card.plain: It lights up on connecting words in the antidepressant warning text about pooled placebo-controlled trials and suicidal thoughts in young patients.
